question: What collection is proclaimed pure in guru-honor-praise?
premises: raga vidya kala yati prakrti aksa artha collection
the guru, in honor-praise, the all-lord
inference: The sense-category collection is declared pure to the guru's glory.
plain_english: Raga vidya kala yati prakrti aksa artha collection — thus pure, having proclaimed, the guru in honor-praise, the all-lord.
